_s9creaking_basis: V/W code-jar javap: V CreakingHeartBlock.CREAKING and BlockStateProperties.CREAKING are one EnumProperty named creaking; W uses ACTIVE and NATURAL. The layer appends the real old property to W's state definition, synchronizes old writes with ACTIVE (DISABLED=false, DORMANT/ACTIVE=true), preserves NATURAL, restores V's day/night transitions at the surviving block-entity tick's second night check and V's ACTIVE-only comparator gate.
